{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model LANS= File:LANS Bomb Arrow Model.png |Model TP= File:TP Bomb Arrow Model.png |Model TPHD= File:TPHD Bomb Arrow Model.png |Model ST= File:ST Bomb Arrow Model.png |Model BotW= File:BotW Bomb Arrow Model.png |Sprite LA= File:LA Bomb Arrow Sprite.png |Sprite LADX= File:LADX Bomb Arrow Sprite.png |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Bomb Arrow Icon.png }} |caption= |type= |game= LA, TP, ST, BotW |other= LCT, HW |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Blasting [[Cracked Wall]]s * Creating ranged explosions * Shooting [[Enemy|Enemies]] }} |strength= 50 |durability= |comp= {{List| * [[Bomb]] * [[Arrow]] }} |sample= |theme= }} '''Bomb Arrows''', also known as '''Exploding Arrows''', are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. They are exploding [[Arrow]]s that result from combining [[Bomb]]s with Arrows. They are shot like normal Arrows, but when the Arrow reaches its target, the Bomb explodes. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Bomb Arrow|Bomb Arrows|Series, TPHD, BotW}} | {{List| * {{TP}}{{Name Ref|TP}} * {{TPHD}} * {{BotW}} }} |- | {{Term/Store|Exploding Arrow|Exploding Arrows|LCT}} | {{LCT}} |- | ''No name is given'' | {{List| * {{LA}} * {{LADX}} * {{LANS}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{LA|-}}=== In {{LA}}, [[Link]] can shoot Bomb Arrows by equipping both the [[Bow]] and [[Bomb]]s and using them at the same time. While they are not required, they can be used as a stronger projectile attack against enemies at the cost of both an [[Arrow]] and a Bomb. They can also be used to blast open some [[Fragile Wall]]s in [[Turtle Rock]], as Link is unable to place a Bomb near the Walls surrounded by [[Lava]]. ==={{TP|-}}=== In {{TP}}, to use a Bomb Arrow, the Hero's Bow must first be equipped, then the ZR Button, R Button ([[GameCube]] version), or Z Button ([[Wii]] version) must be pressed when any kind of [[Bomb]] is selected in the [[Item Screen]]. Bomb Arrows consume both a single Bomb and a single Arrow per shot. They can be fired to create distant blasts in high and low places.{{Cite|Oh...And you can combine bombs and arrows to make bomb arrows for when you need ranged explosives!|Barnes|TP}} They can be used to blow up distant [[Rock]]s, which becomes necessary when [[Link]] ventures to the [[Lakebed Temple]]. Should Link hold the Bomb Arrow to the Hero's Bow for too long, the Bomb Arrow will explode and he will take damage. Bomb Arrows made from [[Water Bomb]]s will not detonate when shot into bodies of water. ==={{ST|-}}=== Bomb Arrows are not a usable item in {{ST}}. Instead, they are fired from [[Bulblin]]s in the [[Overworld]] while riding the [[Spirit Train]]. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Arrow |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Bomb Arrow}} In {{BotW}}, Bomb Arrows appear as a type of Arrow that can be equipped to any [[Bow]]. They can commonly be found in bundles of five, 10, or 20.{{Cite|{{Big|Bomb Arrow x5}}
A bundle of five bomb arrows.
The explosive powder packed into the tips of these arrows ignites on impact, dealing big damage to anything caught in the blast.|N/A|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Bomb Arrow x10}}
A bundle of 10 bomb arrows.
The explosive powder packed into the tips of these arrows ignites on impact, dealing big damage to anything caught in the blast.|N/A|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Bomb Arrow x20}}
A bundle of 20 bomb arrows.
The explosive powder packed into the tips of these arrows ignites on impact, dealing big damage to anything caught in the blast.|N/A|BotW}} They are dropped by some archer [[Bokoblin]]s or [[Lizalfos]], and they can also found inside [[Treasure Chest]]s. In [[Master Mode]], one [[Moblin]] that uses Bomb Arrows can be found near [[Spectacle Rock]] and one [[White-Maned Lynel]] using Bomb Arrows can be found on the [[Great Plateau]]. Before facing their respective [[Divine Beast]]s, [[Teba]] and [[Riju]] will both give Link twenty Bomb Arrows.{{Cite|OK, it's time to face {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast Vah Medoh}}. Normal arrows won't put a dent in those {{Color BotW|Red|cannons}}. You'll need to hit them with {{Color BotW|Blue|bomb arrows}}. These are a precious commodity, so don't expect me to do this again, but... take these {{Color BotW|Blue|bomb arrows}}.|Teba|BotW}}{{Cite|Here are some Gerudo {{Color BotW|Blue|bomb arrows}}. There aren't many, so be sure to put them to good use.|Riju|BotW}} The following locations sell Bomb Arrows: * The [[Arrow Specialty Shop]] in [[Gerudo Town]] * The [[East Wind]] in [[Hateno Village]] * [[The Slippery Falcon]] in [[Rito Village]] * The [[Slippery Falcon (Tarrey Town Branch)]] * [[Shaillu]]'s arrow shop in [[Kara Kara Bazaar]] * [[Jini]] at the [[Mounted Archery Camp]] (when not [[Rain]]ing) Bomb Arrows explode on impact and add an additional 50 damage to the attack power of the Bow being used. If an enemy is hit indirectly with the explosion alone, they are dealt 50 damage no matter what Bow is used. When used against an [[Ice]]-related Enemy, the explosions from Bomb Arrows instantly defeat them.{{Cite|{{Big|Elemental Weaknesses}}
If you use a fiery attack against an icy enemy, you may defeat it in one hit.|Tips and Tricks|BotW}} They are designed to destroy monsters, and they ignite on impact with an enemy. The explosion of a Bomb Arrow can light Enemies and flammable [[Object]]s on [[Fire]]. Like all Arrows, a shot to the head of an enemy deals double the amount of damage. They do not explode in the rain, as the water causes them to fizzle out, but they will still behave like normal Arrows. Instead of disappearing after their detonation, Bomb Arrows bounce off objects while it is raining, and can be picked up and fired again. They will not penetrate and stick to any objects like [[Tree]]s. Bomb Arrows cannot be shot within the [[Scorching Climate]] of the area around [[Death Mountain]], as the Arrows explode immediately and damage Link after the Bow is drawn. ==Other Appearances== ==={{LCT|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Exploding Arrows can be used by holding the trigger on the [[Wii Zapper]] to charge a shot in {{LCT}}. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{HW|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[Linkle]] uses Bomb Arrows as part of the moveset for her [[Crossbows]] Weapon in {{HW}}. Like their appearance in {{LCT}}, she may charge a shot before firing a Bomb Arrow at enemies. She can also unleash a barrage of Arrows and Bomb Arrows. During her Crossbows Weapon's [[Focus Spirit Attack]], Linkle fires a giant Bomb attached to an Arrow before smashing it to the ground with a fiery kick. In the {{ALBW|-}} DLC Pack, [[Ravio]] uses Bombs attached to [[Light Arrow]]s as part of the [[Special Attack]] for his [[Rental Hammer]] Weapon. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== *During development of {{ALttP}}, Bomb Arrows were planned to appear. They were set to be shot by pressing the A and B Buttons simultaneously when the Bow and Bombs were equipped at the same time. The idea was scrapped after [[Shigeru Miyamoto]] requested that Link should always have the Sword equipped. This idea was later implemented in {{LA|-}}.{{Cite Person|quote= We also thought about having these weapons combine, say for example, having the Bow & Arrows set to the A Button and a Bomb to B Button so that when you use them together (i.e. press both the buttons), Link would shoot an arrow with a bomb attached. In the end we didn’t use this in A Link To The Past, as Shigeru Miyamoto requested that Link always have the sword equipped. We were able to implement this system in the next title, Link’s Awakening, though.|name= Takashi Tezuka|url= http://nintendoeverything.com/nintendo-on-zelda-link-to-the-past-scrapped-idea-working-with-snes-master-sword-importance-more/|title= Nintendo on Zelda: Link to the Past – scrapped idea, working with SNES, Master Sword importance, more}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:HW Ravio Bomb Arrows.png|{{Game Label|{{HW|-}}}}Ravio with Bomb Arrows ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ancient Arrow * Arrow * Fire Arrow * Ice Arrow * Light Arrow * Shock Arrow }} {{Ref| {{Cite Guide|LADX Prima|page= 3}} {{Cite|Oh...
